cabinet/cabinet-base.png.what: Tiling cabinet base with brass feet
cabinet/cabinet-base.png.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: source artwork for a vertically tiling cabinet, to be cut into a crown, one repeated shelf row, and a base.
Input images: Image 1 is design/art/style-sheet.png, the approved style reference: match this style exactly. Image 2 is design/art/shelf.png, the existing shelf reference: same wood, brass and line style as this shelf.
Create one tall, straight-on front-view wooden cabinet with a slight top-down angle showing the top surface of each board, like Image 2. Warm brown wood posts at the same x positions from top to bottom, brass ball finials above, brass brackets at the far left and right of each board, brass feet below. A continuous opaque cream #F3E2BB wallpaper or light-wood back panel fills between the posts, with very subtle paper grain. Outside the posts is fully transparent. The cabinet is empty: no vessels, plaques, text or symbols.
Composition: portrait image, cabinet fills nearly all canvas width. Left post outer edge about 2.3% and inner edge about 9.4% of width; right inner edge about 90.6% and outer edge about 97.7%. Three identical shelf bays with evenly spaced boards; each bay is tall enough for a vessel above the board. Board front faces are plain, about 52 px high after scaling to 1024 px wide. Board tops are visible, standing surfaces flat and horizontal. Keep central horizontal region x 17.2%-82.8% very plain and uniform at every x: horizontal wood grain on boards; flat back panel with fine grain only; no knots, vertical grooves, brackets or localized light spots. Put all hardware outside that region. At every horizontal cut through the posts and back panel, their width, color, and shading stay continuous. Avoid perspective taper; all boards are level and full width.
The final tiles will be composited with three or five vessels on each shelf, so leave the bays empty and spacious.
The view instruction here replaces the three-quarter view and square-canvas instruction below for this cabinet only. Keep every other part of the style block unchanged.

App: 時光膠囊 / Time Capsule. People send a sealed letter that can only be opened at a set time and place. Mood: tender, human, nostalgic, "precious in the AI age". Hand-inked storybook, not glossy 3D.
- Clean ink line art with a slightly hand-drawn line, flat colour fills plus one soft shading tone, a little paper grain, light hatching only (it must still read at about 120 px). Lines in plum #6E2B3F or navy #16263F.
- Palette only: ink blue #2F5D8A, light blue #5A8FD0, glass blue #DCE8F2, plum #6E2B3F, brass #C9A15A, wax red #A3364F, navy #16263F, paper #F6F8FB, cream #F3E2BB. Warm brown wood is allowed for wooden objects.
- Front three-quarter view, soft top-left light. No text, letters, numbers, logos or real brands.
- Transparent background, object centred, generous padding (object fills about 70% of the canvas), square.
Match the attached style sheet exactly.
cabinet/cabinet-base.png.postprocess: Cut, horizontally aligned, flattened in the x=176–848 stretch zone, and seam-matched by _checks/build-cabinet-tiles.py.
